tools.name: search_robot_training_jobs
tools.description: Search the open robot training jobs (paid work piloting, teaching, recording for and testing robots, autonomous vehicles and drones) across about 60 employers and programs such as Tesla, Figure, Waymo, Zipline, micro1 and Claru. Returns each role's title, employer, kind of work, advertised pay, wher

tools.name: get_robot_training_pay
tools.description: What robot training work pays per hour today, by kind of work: the median and the typical range (25th to 75th percentile) of the rates open roles advertise, with how many rates and employers each figure comes from. A rate is shown only when at least three employers advertise it.

tools.name: get_robot_training_market
tools.description: How many robot training jobs are open right now, how many were listed in the last 7 days, and the open roles by kind of work and by employer (with each employer's slug for search_robot_training_jobs). Optionally scoped to the roles open to applicants in one country.
